name: What is the difference between a site survey and a site feasibility consultation?
description: A site survey maps property features, while a feasibility consultation evaluates building viability based on regulations, utilities, and site challenges.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a site survey and a site feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A site survey is a technical document prepared by a licensed surveyor that precisely maps property boundaries, existing structures, topographical features, and easements. A site feasibility consultation, while utilizing survey data if available, goes beyond mapping to evaluate the practical and regulatory aspects of building a tiny home on that specific site. It assesses zoning compliance, utility connections, and potential construction challenges, offering a holistic view of the project's viability.
